label: Work & Office
description: Everyday workplace talk — meetings, tasks, colleagues, and schedules.

missions.phrase: Доброе утро, я пришёл на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: arriving at the office. The line opens with a polite доброе утро and announces пришёл на работу. Use it when greeting colleagues at the start of the day.
Strategic focus: announcing a meeting. The noun совещание names a formal work meeting and начнётся states when it starts. The time через десять минут keeps everyone on schedule.
Strategic focus: asking a colleague for help. The address коллега opens a friendly request and помочь names the favour. Use this informal ты form with people you work alongside daily.
Strategic focus: checking a deadline. The noun срок means deadline and задача names the assigned task. This question clarifies when work must be finished.
Strategic focus: promising to send a file. The verb отправлю is the future of отправить and документ names the file. The polite вам suits a message to a manager or client.
Strategic focus: suggesting a lunch break. The noun перерыв means break and обеденный marks it as the lunch one. The invitation пойдём вместе keeps it casual and friendly.
Strategic focus: addressing the boss. The noun начальник names the manager and можно softens the request. The phrase задать вопрос is the standard way to ask permission to speak.
Strategic focus: declining politely. The opener извините apologises and занят states the speaker is busy. The marker сейчас limits the refusal to the present moment.
Strategic focus: reporting a finished task. The verb закончил signals completion and проект names the long task. Use this to update a colleague or manager on your progress.

missions.phrase: Рабочий день закончился, я ухожу домой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: leaving for the day. The phrase рабочий день закончился marks the end of work and ухожу домой states the departure. This is a natural way to say goodbye at the office.
